headline: A 1995 executive order by President Clinton on how federal government contracts are managed and completed.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets policy aimed at making sure federal contracts are run and finished in an economical and efficient way. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, requirements, or limits it places on contracts cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.group: Companies that hold or seek federal government contracts
who_it_affects.how: The order appears to set policies that affect how their federal contracts are managed and completed.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that award and oversee contracts
who_it_affects.how: The order appears to direct how agencies handle the administration of their contracts.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 8, 1995; the title does not state a separate effective date.
